name: Augustana Interregional Invitational
where: Rock Island, IL · host Augustana · Saukie Golf Course
headline: Augustana Interregional Invitational
summary: Final: Men: No. 1 Wartburg won the Gold race with 64 points, ahead of No. 11 North Central (107), No. 4 UW-La Crosse (121) and No. 9 Washington University (141), and Wartburg's Isaiah Hammerand won the 8K in 23:46.2. Women: No. 3 UW-La Crosse scored 67 to beat No. 5 Chicago (137), No. 7 Washington University (177) and No. 15 Emory (191), and Colorado College's Charlie Flint won the 6K in 20:54.5.
